review_metadata.manifest_rule: decoded manifest and referenced network-security XML; exported categories mean explicit android:exported=true, matching comparison catalog v1.1
review_metadata.code_scope: externally invocable Android inputs (Intent, URI, Bundle, BroadcastReceiver or ContentProvider parameters) reaching the critical sink
review_metadata.interface_only_policy: interface-only flows are recorded as false because the SMALIRIS study scope is exposed Android boundaries
review_metadata.positive_code_rule: a positive requires a manually confirmed source-to-critical-argument path; sink presence alone is insufficient
review_metadata.negative_code_rule: a negative requires no qualifying flow after app-owned Smali sink inventory and path inspection

category_definitions.APP_DEBUGGABLE: Application explicitly or effectively runs with android:debuggable=true.
category_definitions.EXPORTED_ACTIVITY: At least one activity/activity-alias explicitly declares android:exported=true.
category_definitions.EXPORTED_SERVICE: At least one service explicitly declares android:exported=true.
category_definitions.EXPORTED_RECEIVER: At least one receiver explicitly declares android:exported=true.
category_definitions.EXPORTED_PROVIDER: At least one provider explicitly declares android:exported=true.
category_definitions.BROWSABLE_DEEP_LINK: At least one intent filter includes android.intent.category.BROWSABLE.
category_definitions.CLEARTEXT_TRAFFIC: Cleartext is allowed globally or by network security configuration/platform default for the APK target SDK.
category_definitions.SQL_INJECTION_RISK: An exposed Android input controls an SQL-critical argument without a sufficient boundary/parameterization that removes structural control.
category_definitions.WEBVIEW_UNTRUSTED_URL: An exposed Android input controls the URL passed to WebView.loadUrl.
category_definitions.COMMAND_EXECUTION: An exposed Android input controls the command or arguments passed to Runtime.exec/ProcessBuilder.
